svg.title: 4A · Raka mislabels his sadness
svg.desc: Raka sits alone at the desk after missing his target. He leans forward, lowers his gaze, and presses both hands to his temples; the cup and Dina are absent. The thought cloud is a compact editable overlay.
svg.metadata: Scene 4A composition vector-traced from the Agy-generated pose reference; editable text cards and the thought cloud are SVG overlays. Raka is alone, seated at the desk with a lowered head, both hands at his temples, and no cup or handheld device.
